name: Spells a talent teaches as temporary are taught again quietly at every login
contract: A temporary spell is never saved, so after a relog the script that grants it teaches it again with
SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL: Falconstrike 806443 (talent 573060, OnPlayerLogin), Wind Gate: Evacuate 504643 (Wind Gate
504401, OnPlayerLogin), Spindlebind's Tunneler variant 504706 (630932, OnPlayerUpdate), Ballad of the Conqueror
(Inspiration, OnPlayerUpdate), Black Ward 804711 (AscensionCultist::Refresh every 500 ms while Inner Darkness
706182 is up and Abyssal Ward 804670 is known, AscensionCultist.cpp:249-262) and Malefic Arrow 801674
(AscensionWitchDoctor::SyncReplacements from witch_doctor_update::OnUnitUpdate every 500 ms while the Malefic
Arrow talent 707854 or Shadowhunter 92086 is up, AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:41-55 and 445-461). A loud learn
prints a line and makes the client place the spell on an empty button. With CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.Silent
every temporary learn is quiet, including Black Ward, which has no SpellCustomAttr row in the client's table or
the book data and needs a synthesized quiet row. Expected for each class: the spell is known again after the
relog, the client printed no line for it and an empty button stays empty.
